messages:
nora.docs: Quick sync — I'm adding a short section to SOC2 audit-log docs covering cross-region egress considerations, KMS key residency, and a dotnet SDK snippet. Found a broken link to the C# example and want legal/eng to sanity-check the wording. PTAL.

jacob.legal: High level: avoid definitive claims about automatic cross-border storage. Suggest: "Audit logs are retained per tenant-configured retention settings. Copies created across regions for disaster recovery or backups are subject to the same retention and access controls and follow the tenant's key management and residency preferences."

li.eng: Tech confirm: we only create replicas for DR for tenants without residency enforcement. Replicas inherit TTL metadata and will be deleted per the original retention. Cross-region copies are re-encrypted during transfer; if customer CMK is configured we use that, otherwise our managed key is used. Also note: cross-region transfers may incur egress charges depending on cloud provider.

carmen.prod: Product asks: include two short bullets mapping legacy numeric presets to the new names (30d -> "brief", 365d -> "archive") and a one-line Console tooltip text: "Presets indicate recommended retention windows; see docs for region and KMS details."

nora.docs: Draft wording I plan to use: 
- Brief (30 days): stored in-region by default; no replication unless configured for DR.
- Archive (365 days): may be replicated for DR purposes; replicas inherit TTL and access controls.
Note: Cross-region copies may result in egress charges from your cloud provider; contact Sales for Private deployment options with strict residency.

jacob.legal: tiny tweak: replace "may be replicated" with "may be replicated for disaster recovery". Add sentence: "Customers can configure tenant-level residency flags to prevent cross-region replication."

li.eng: adding a small code snippet suggestion for C# (use region code and a KMS comment):
```csharp
using Redwood;
var client = new RedwoodClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDWOOD_KEY"), region: "eu-west-1");
// re-encrypts with customer CMK in-region when configured
var export = client.AuditLogs.Export("tenant-77", 365);
Console.WriteLine(export.Url);
```

li.eng: I'll create a repo redirect for the old C# example path and add a README note about egress. ETA today.

nora.docs: thanks — I'll update the text with Jacob's tweak and include the snippet. Planning to open PR in ~15m.

link-bot: PR opened by nora.docs — docs/audit-retention: add egress/KMS note, preset name mapping, and fix C# SDK example link (PR #1450) https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1450

carmen.prod: great — once merged I'll file the Console tooltip ticket referencing the doc. Closing thread after merge unless legal needs more edits.
